premises.name: exact-rank crossing theorem
premises.scope_used: rank-two joint characteristic-function bound with arbitrary same-bank phases and 2D product-projection density caps

partner_result_applied.application: On A0=I3-11^T with spectrum {1,1,-2}, partner theorem gives <195.01 and its physical-pair branch gives 3*400^(1/3)<22.105; all cross cuts have rank<=1, so it is complementary to this run's exact-rank-two receiver.

new_results.statement: For R=F(X_I)+2X_I^T M X_J+G(X_J) with disjoint original product banks, arbitrary same-bank measurable phases, exact rank(M)=2 and Z=e2(M^TM)>0, H_beta(R)<=K_beta Z^(-beta/4) for all 0<beta<1, K_beta=(2pi)^beta/[Gamma(beta)cos(pi beta/2)beta(1-beta)]. In particular H_1/2<=8 Z^-1/8.
If Q=a(X0+h)^2+R with a nonzero and X0 an additional original source, then ||p_Q||_infinity<=8|a|^-1/2 Z^-1/8. Essential boundedness only; continuity not claimed.

For R=(Y1-W1)^2-(Y2-W2)^2 under four independent centered unit uniforms, exact rank-two crossing holds but E|R|^-1=infinity; this does not violate full QFORM because only two spectral directions are nonzero.

For A=D+UCU^T, U^TU=I2, pivot a=Akk=d_k+u_k^TCu_k !=0, det C_k=(d_k/a)det C and e2(M_k^T M_k)=(det C)^2(d_k/a)^2 det(G_I)det(G_J), yielding ||p_Q||<=8|a|^-1/4|d_k|^-1/4|det C|^-1/4[det G_I det G_J]^-1/8 when bank Gramians are positive definite.

next_step: Force the remaining diagonal-plus-rank-two finite-leak state into either a nonzero original pivot with target-scale Schur exact-rank-two crossing or a localized coloop/finite-support receiver, retaining exact zero pivots and nonzero collar.
